title.narrative: Preparation of the Report on Gap analysis of the Montenegrin Legal and Regulatory Framework compared to the SEPA regulation

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to contribute to the preparation of Montenegro¿s economy for the EU Single Market through joining the Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA).

Performing the Gap analysis of the current Montenegrin legislation and regulatory framework in relation to the SEPA regulation and technical requirements and providing recommendations for the fulfilment of SEPA criteria.
